newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas in 8 pct pay rise over 2 yrs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas in 8 pct pay rise over 2 yrs.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Friday that the airline has finalised a two-year industrial relations accord with unions covering Australia-based employees.
Qantas said the agreement provided a wage increase of eight percent in four equal increments over two years.

Qantas managing director James Strong said the wage deal is part of an enterprise bargaining agreement with the Australian and International Pilot's Association covering pilots employed on Qantas Boeing 747 and 767 aircraft.
Strong said in a statement Qantas had achieved productivity gains in the negotiations with each of the unions.
At 3.05 p.m. (0405 GMT), Qantas shares were two cents up at A$2.08.
Qantas is 25 percent owned by British Airways Plc.
